in_sanskrit.name: जलधर
in_sanskrit.meaning: वृक्षमेरुदल्लाशात् जलधरो नाम तस्य यस्य विद्यते जलधि घनाश्च
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who removes the sorrows of the body and mind, like a tree removes the suffering of thirst, is named Jaladhar.

in_hindi.name: जलधर
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who holds or bears the water.

in_tamil.name: ஜலதர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who holds or carries water.

in_telugu.name: జలదర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who holds or supports water.

in_marathi.name: Jaladhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mover of water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaladhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaladhar means the one who holds or mover of water. It is derived from the Sanskrit words Jala (water) and Dhara (holder or bearer). This name is associated with the god Varuna, who is the god of water, oceans and rivers.

It is derived from the Sanskrit words Jala (water) and Dhara (holder or bearer). This name is associated with the god Varuna, who is the god of water, oceans and rivers.
